name: Okamoto Industries, Inc.
summary: Okamoto Industries, Inc. manufactures and sells industrial and household products in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It offers industrial products, including plastic films for general goods, stationery; wallpaper for housing, decorative films for kitchen cabinets, doors, building materials, moldable ABS and acrylic sheets, and synthetic leather for sofas and furniture; automotive materials; agricultural films/work materials; and food wrapping films, absorbent/dehydrant sheets, gloves, and other food sanitation materials.
